message:
Fix broken email system + mid-stream error UX

- Replace all nodemailer/Gmail SMTP with Resend HTTP API
  (Gmail SMTP ports 465/587 are blocked on Render free tier IPs)
- sendReceiptEmail, sendPlanWelcomeEmail, sendWelcomeEmail,
  notify-policy-update endpoint all now use sendResendEmail()
- Add sendResendEmail() helper using RESEND_API_KEY env var
- Mid-stream AI error: append error note to partial reply bubble
  instead of silently swallowing it (gotFirst=true case in app.js)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
